# Rapier Collision Queries

Unmodified `dist/rapier.mjs` from `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0`, bundled locally
with its Apache-2.0 LICENSE. WASM is embedded; no CDN or paid services.
Npm tarball SHA1: `a3e5ab3dd0f13d28a6933589b8b8a869c63574ee`.

Used for convex torso/head versus arm-capsule contact queries, not a dynamic
ragdoll or gravity simulation. Camera-driven bone lengths remain fixed.
API: https://www.rapier.rs/javascript3d/classes/Collider.html#contactShape
